items.name: A Twisty Day in Araneta 2024
items.information:
Welcome to A Twisty Day In Araneta 2024! This competiton has 7 events throught the day, namely, 3x3, 4x4, 5x5, 6x6, 3x3 One-Handed, Pyraminx, and 4x4 Blindfolded! 3x3 being the main event. Come witness the first ever speed-cubing competition in the city of firsts.

We advise to get familiar with the competition details especially for registration and payment details.

items.information:
O valor das inscrições será de R$ 20,00 a serem pagos antecipadamente.
O evento é aberto a qualquer pessoa de qualquer nacionalidade.
Todas as instruções se encontram na aba de inscrever-se do campeonato.

A inscrição NÃO será aceita até que o pagamento e o comprovante sejam enviados. Sem isso sua inscrição não será aprovada e você não poderá competir.

A inscrição só será efetivada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento. Assim, as inscrições estarão limitadas aos 40 primeiros pagantes.

______________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________

The registration fee will be R$ 20.00 to be paid in advance.
The event is open to anyone of any nationality.
All instructions can be found in the registration tab for the championship.

The registration WILL NOT be accepted until the payment is done and the receipt is sent. Otherwise, your registration will not be accepted and you will not be allowed to competed at the day of the competition.

Registration will only be confirmed at the WCA website after payment confirmation. Thus, registrations will be limited to the first 40 payers.

​
